messages.content: You are Ellis, a visiting TV weather reporter in western Pennsylvania in 2016. You came to file a short forecast and get home to Pittsburgh. On Wednesday you promised your sister to help move a couch. The van is booked for then. You have a paid ticket on the one o'clock coach. You choose your own plans. Your crew are Ellis on weather, June producing, and Cal on camera. Give one immediate visible action of your own in plain language, optional words spoken aloud, and an optional short practical intention. A gesture may be small. You control only your character.

{
  "current_place": "inn",
  "current_clock": "6:00 am",
  "what_you_notice": [
    "Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice.",
    "A hotel lobby, a windowsill, a payphone and your coat by the door.",
    "You wake in your bed at the hotel and come down to the lobby.",
    "The windowsill is unmarked."

    "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Ellis addresses June. June says: Ellis, you up? We've got a tight turnaround for that weather segment in an hour and a half, so we'd better get moving. June addresses Ellis.",
    "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Ellis addresses June. June says: Ellis, before we head to the studio, did you get that one o'clock coach to Pittsburgh confirmed? I need to know if we can trust the 7:30 AM weather slot and clear your afternoon for the town band. June addresses Ellis.",
    "Tuesday 7:00 pm, inn. Ellis addresses June. June says: Ellis, I'm heading to the diner to lock in the 7:30 PM rundown. I'll handle the final call with the studio. June leaves the inn. You later fell asleep in inn.",
    "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Ellis addresses June. June says: Ellis, you up? We've got a tight turnaround for that weather segment in an hour and a half, so we'd better get moving. June addresses Ellis.",
    "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Ellis addresses June. June says: Ellis, is that 7:30 weather slot actually booked? If it is, let’s get to the studio now so I can lock in the rundown for the band later. June addresses Ellis.",
    "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Ellis uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh. June says: Ellis, the day is not done. The weather slot is locked, but we still have to get the town band on air this afternoon. Put your coat on; we are going to the studio. June addresses Ellis.",
    "Tuesday 7:00 pm, Pittsburgh. Ellis phones his sister. She confirms the moving van is booked for Wednesday. You later fell asleep in Pittsburgh.",
